item: OSM lane API details and region downloads onto the shared scrub
summary: The OpenStreetMap lane's refusal details (six routes echoing a typed country code or a domain error) and the region download manager's stored error and log lines go through secret_scrub: exception_text (a UnicodeError by class alone, any held passphrase taken out) and log_failure instead of str(exc) and exc_info=True, so src/geo/osm_downloads.py leaves the exc_info list. Completeness's own error texts were already moved in the scrub adoption. Tests: each route's detail with a held passphrase and a UnicodeError, the passphrase typed as the country, a download failure stored/logged/state-file clean, an unreadable state file; each fails when its scrub is removed (mutated).
